title: 20(S)-Protopanaxadiol Targets HMGB1 to Inhibit Inflammasome Activation and Ameliorate Acute Lung Injury.
authors: Li, Junyao; Li, Jing; Dai, Jiawei; Hu, Jianping; Wang, Yuhan; Yan, Pengrui; Wang, Honggang; Hu, Weicheng
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人参皂苷代谢物PPD靶向HMGB1蛋白抑制炎症小体活化，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作（HMGB1-TLR4）及分子对接/MD模拟，但核心对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA结合机制课题关联度低。
abstract: 20(S)-Protopanaxadiol (PPD), a major intestinal metabolite of ginsenosides from Panax ginseng, possesses anti-inflammatory properties, yet its direct molecular targets are poorly defined. This study investigated the protective effects of PPD against acute lung injury (ALI) and its potential mechanism. Using LPS-challenged immortalized mouse bone-marrow-derived macrophages (iBMDMs) and ALI mouse models, limited proteolysis-mass spectrometry identified HMGB1 as the primary binding target. PPD blocked inflammasome activation and interrupted HMGB1-TLR4 interaction. Molecular docking, dynamics simulations, and site mutagenesis verified that PPD stably binds the HMGB1 B-box domain. In vivo, PPD mitigated pulmonary damage, alleviated alveolar edema and inflammatory infiltration, lowered proinflammatory cytokines, and restrained HMGB1 secretion. In conclusion, PPD directly targets HMGB1 to block HMGB1-TLR4 inflammatory signaling. These data suggest PPD can serve as a promising functional food constituent for ALI prevention.
abstract_zh: 20(S)-原人参二醇（PPD）是人参中人参皂苷的主要肠道代谢产物，具有抗炎特性，但其直接分子靶点尚不明确。本研究探讨了PPD对急性肺损伤（ALI）的保护作用及其潜在机制。利用脂多糖（LPS）刺激的永生化小鼠骨髓来源巨噬细胞（iBMDMs）和ALI小鼠模型，通过有限蛋白水解-质谱法鉴定出HMGB1为主要结合靶点。PPD阻断炎症小体激活并干扰HMGB1-TLR4相互作用。分子对接、动力学模拟和位点突变验证表明，PPD稳定结合HMGB1的B-box结构域。在体内实验中，PPD减轻了肺损伤，缓解了肺泡水肿和炎症浸润，降低了促炎细胞因子水平，并抑制了HMGB1的分泌。总之，PPD直接靶向HMGB1以阻断HMGB1-TLR4炎症信号通路。这些数据表明，PPD可作为预防ALI的有前景的功能性食品成分。
